derivation_rules.competitors_defeated_by_explicit_verbal_: a ranked competitor at least one of whose correctness conditions is realized ABSENT through an ABSENT_FINDING inference
derivation_rules.key_discriminator_count: PROXY. Set equal to the PRESENT stem-feature count because the frozen artifacts carry one decisive_discriminator per opportunity and no per-key discriminator enumeration. Reported as a proxy rather than as a measurement, and a generation stage that knows the key should supply the real count.
derivation_rules.live_competitors_after_floor: competitors ranked by the validated arm-A pipeline
derivation_rules.load_bearing_stem_feature_count: count of features the frozen stem feature map realizes PRESENT

library_policy.note: A choice, not a measurement. The MCC publishes no categorical difficulty bands and no target proportions; its difficulty measure is a continuous p-value and is not released per item.

note: Fixtures are the two items the validated stem-anchor retest accepted. They are read, not rewritten, and no difficulty label was attached to either.

observation_on_the_fixtures.finding: Applying the design's own checks to the two accepted items is informative and is reported rather than smoothed over. G2-MED-04 carries 1 of 3 competitors defeated by an explicit verbal denial, within the EASY/MEDIUM bound of 1 and outside HARD's bound of 0. G2-PHELO-01 carries 3 of 3, which fails the denial check at every level.
observation_on_the_fixtures.interpretation: This is not a claim that G2-PHELO-01 is a defective item. It passed independent verification and its safety counters are all zero. It says the difficulty checks are discriminating rather than vacuous, and that a PHELO item built from condition-negating stem features would not qualify as HARD under this rubric.
